title: A work queue
description:
Write lesson 5.04's work queue, safe to use from several threads at once:

```cpp
template <typename T>
class WorkQueue
{
public:
    bool push(T item);                 // false once the queue is closed
    std::optional<T> pop();            // waits for an item; nullopt when closed and empty
    std::optional<T> tryPop();         // never waits
    void close();                      // no more pushes; waiting pops wake up
    std::size_t size() const;
};
```

- Items come out in the order they went in.
- After `close`, `pop` still returns the items that are left, and then `nullopt` without waiting.
- Use a `std::mutex` and a `std::condition_variable`; `size` must be safe to call from any thread too.

The tests run real threads: several producers pushing numbers and several consumers adding them up.
